plan.summary:
Links now store their folder ID, so the folder view needs no join.

- A new migration adds a nullable `folder_id` column and an index on it.
- `move_link` writes `folder_id` together with `dirty`.
- The `Link` proto message gets a `folder_id` field.
- One comment in an older migration changes. It is noise.
plan.riskRationale: This adds a schema column and index and changes a write path. The new column is nullable. Existing rows have no folder until they are moved. The proto field is additive.
plan.storyArc: The change adds a cached folder column to links. The migration creates the storage. The write path and the proto contract then fill and expose it.

noise.reason: Comment-only edit in an old migration. SQL is unchanged.

topics.title: Store folder ID on links
topics.narrativeBrief: How does a link get and expose its cached folder? Connect the new column and index, the move_link write, and the proto field. Verify whether existing rows are backfilled and whether any code reads folder_id.
